name: worktodo
title: Worktodo
description: Keep your tasks close at hand in the menu bar. Check priorities, see what’s due, and complete tasks without opening the full list. Use Raycast to capture tasks and organize them with projects, labels, due dates, and notes. Tasks are stored locally on your Mac, with no account required.
author: jsn

scripts.lint: CI=true ray lint && eslint mcp tests
scripts.verify: npm run format && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run build:mcp
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "throw new Error('Use npm run publish for the Raycast Store')"

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Worktodo
commands.description: See priority tasks, overdue work, and tasks due this week from your menu bar. Complete, edit, or open a task from its submenu, or quickly create a new one.

commands.name: my-tasks
commands.title: All Tasks
commands.subtitle: Worktodo
commands.description: Search and manage your tasks in one place. Browse by project, label, Today, or This Week, and keep context with notes and due dates. Review completed tasks and recover items from Trash.

commands.name: quick-add
commands.title: Quick Add
commands.subtitle: Worktodo
commands.description: Capture a task without opening the full list. Start with a title, then add a project, labels, a due date, or notes as needed.

commands.name: backup-restore
commands.title: Backup & Restore
commands.subtitle: Worktodo
commands.description: Export your tasks to a JSON backup or preview a backup before restoring it. Restoring replaces your current data, with a recovery backup created automatically first.
